articles.title: Analysts split on whether Bitcoin's surge past key levels signals a new bull run
articles.snippet: Market watchers say sudden sharp price spikes and forced short liquidations are the classic signs of a bottom, though macro risks still remain.

articles.title: Ripple backs an RLUSD credit fund amid XRP's best week in months
articles.snippet: Clearpool and Cicada Partners are building an institutional lending product using RLUSD, though the XRP Ledger features underpinning it are still awaiting activation.

articles.title: Digital Asset, Paul Ryan foundation target US state benefits with Canton pilot
articles.snippet: The RISE program would use the Canton Network to combine and distribute state-administered benefits across three US states beginning in 2027.

articles.title: Coldcard strengthens seed generation with firmware update
articles.snippet: Coinkite urged Coldcard users to generate new seed phrases, warning that existing vulnerable seeds remain unsafe despite the security upgrade.

articles.title: Capital.com plans UAE spot crypto services after affiliate wins licence
articles.snippet: UAE clients will be able to buy and hold crypto through Capital.com’s app, expanding beyond price exposure through contracts for difference.
